# Adler Giersch

> > Adler Giersch is a Seattle-based personal injury law firm with 35+ years of experience providing compassionate counsel and tough advocacy for traumatic brain injuries, car accidents, and wrongful death cases.

Based in the Pacific Northwest with offices in Seattle, Issaquah, and Everett, Adler Giersch specializes in complex personal injury litigation. The firm is known for its multilingual services, community partnerships, and track record of substantial verdicts and settlements.
